title: Web webhooks and audit UI
goal: Workspace admins can create, test, rotate and monitor webhook endpoints and browse and export the audit log from the web app, with secrets shown exactly once.
scope_in: Webhooks via CT-API-WEBHOOKS: list, create (url HTTPS, `events[]` from the CT-WEBHOOKS event type list, Idempotency-Key required), PATCH url/events/enabled, `rotate_secret:true`, DELETE, `POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/test`, deliveries list and redeliver.

One-time secret reveal: modal with copy button, explicit 'I saved it' close, secret held in memory only and cleared on close; shows `Centcom-Signature` header format and a copy-paste verification snippet (HMAC-SHA256 over `t + "." + raw_body`, 300 s tolerance).
Delivery log table with status, attempt, time, redeliver action; endpoint health chip (`failing`, disabled) with the 7-attempt retry schedule explained.

Audit viewer via GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/audit with filters `actor`, `action`, `from`, `to`, cursor pagination, and export via POST .../audit/exports then poll GET .../audit/exports/{exp} for download.
Entitlement-aware states: `webhooks_max` and `audit_log_days` (0 = feature off) shown via empty/upgrade-hint states.
scope_out: Webhook delivery, signing and retry on the server; CLI webhook commands (C069) and audit commands (C070).
Receiving webhooks (no receiver in the web app).
Billing flows and workspace RBAC admin.
build_against: Mock backend (lane C007) with webhook endpoints, delivery logs (including failing), audit events and export job states; signed example payloads from fixtures/webhooks/*.json when present.
interfaces: export function verifySnippet(lang: 'node'|'python'|'curl'): string  // static docs text, no secrets
export function useAuditLog(wsp: WorkspaceId, f: AuditFilter): {pages: AuditEvent[][]; fetchMore(): Promise<void>}
WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPES: readonly string[]  // exactly the list in CT-WEBHOOKS
acceptance: Creating an endpoint with an `http://` URL (non-localhost) is rejected client-side with an inline error before any request; `https://` succeeds with an Idempotency-Key header.
The signing secret appears once; after closing the modal it cannot be re-shown (test reloads the page and asserts absence in DOM, memory store and storage).
Rotate secret shows the new secret once and a note about the 24 h overlap (both `v1` signatures sent).
Event picker lists exactly the 18 event type strings of CT-WEBHOOKS (grouped by prefix) and sends only the selected types in `events[]`.
Deliveries table shows the 7 retry attempts' states and `Redeliver` posts with Idempotency-Key; failure to redeliver toasts the CT-ERR message.
Audit export: POST creates an export, UI polls every 3 s up to 2 min, then offers download link; if `audit_log_days` is 0 the audit route shows the feature-off state with a billing link.
Audit filters round-trip through URL query (`actor`, `action`, `from`, `to`) without storing anything sensitive; keyboard-only operable; axe 0 serious/critical.
Non-admin roles see neither routes nor nav items and get a neutral 403 page when deep-linking.
guardrails: MUST NOT persist, log or put webhook secrets in URLs, storage or error reports; clear after modal close.
MUST enforce HTTPS in the form (localhost only when the workspace is in test mode as indicated by the API) in addition to server validation.
MUST NOT render audit `details` as HTML; show text only and truncate to 500 chars with an expand control.
Admin-only: MUST NOT fetch these endpoints for roles lacking permission (avoids audited denied attempts).
failure_modes: Test delivery times out (10 s) -> show the delivery with `timeout` status and the retry schedule.
Export job fails -> danger banner with retry; polling stops.
Webhooks limit reached -> create disabled with entitlement message.
